method.unit: one ordinary query in one newly launched ripgrep process
method.secondary_comparison: preserved upstream binary versus same candidate binary flag off
method.order: adjacent alternating AB/BA, phase rotated by cell
method.clock: time.perf_counter_ns around subprocess.run through child exit and pipe drain
method.correctness: status and literal stdout/stderr bytes checked on every pair
method.application_aot_cache: none; every flagged sample recompiles in its fresh process
method.filesystem_cache: warm OS cache after unrecorded warmup pairs
method.tmpdir: unique per invocation; unexpected persistent files are fatal
method.receipt: unique create-new sidecar written before child exit; parsing is outside timer

receipt_timings.prepare_ns: compile plus object write, clang link, dlopen/dlsym
receipt_timings.ready_ns_since_start: publication readiness relative to coordinator start
